Wolf Companion: A loyal wolf that follows you. Keep it fed, watered, and happy or it will eventually leave.
狼伙伴: 一只忠诚的狼跟随着你。保持喂养、给水和互动，否则它最终会离开。

Wolf Companion: Start with a loyal wolf companion.
狼伙伴: 开始时携带一只忠诚的狼伙伴。

Wolf Companion: Give the wolf a meal. It wags its tail.
狼伙伴: 给狼一顿饭。它摇着尾巴。

Wolf Companion: Offer the wolf a drink from a water container.
Spend a quiet moment with your companion by the fire.
狼伙伴: 在火旁与你的伙伴共度一段安静的时光。

Wolf Companion: Chase, wrestle and tumble through the forest together. Pure joy.
狼伙伴: 一起在森林中追逐、摔跤和翻滚。纯粹的快乐。

Wolf Companion: The wolf disappears into the undergrowth. It returns with prey — a squirrel, perhaps a partridge, rarely a hare.
狼伙伴: 狼消失在灌木丛中。它带着猎物回来了。

Wolf Companion: Follow the wolf as it reads the forest. Your tracking improves.
狼伙伴: 跟随狼读懂森林。你的追踪技能提升了。

Wolf Companion: The wolf patrols the perimeter while you rest. You sleep more soundly.
狼伙伴: 你休息时狼在周围巡逻。你睡得更安稳了。

Wolf Companion: Send the wolf ahead on the trail. Prey scatter; you pick off stragglers.
狼伙伴: 让狼在猎径上打前哨。猎物四散逃跑，你拦截落单者。

Wolf Companion: Apply the remedy to the wolf's injuries. It holds still while you work.
狼伙伴: 将药物涂抹在狼的伤口上。它一动不动地让你处理。

Wolf Companion: A wild sheep roaming the forest. Offer it fresh meadowgrass to tame it, or slaughter it for resources.
狼伙伴: 一只在森林中游荡的野生绵羊。喂它新鲜草地牧草可以驯服它，或将其屠宰以获取资源。

Wolf Companion: A wild ram. Offer it fresh meadowgrass to tame it, or slaughter it for resources.
狼伙伴: 一只野生公羊。喂它新鲜草地牧草可以驯服它，或将其屠宰以获取资源。

Wolf Companion: A tame sheep. Shear it for wool, keep it near a ram to breed over time, or slaughter it.
狼伙伴: 一只驯养的绵羊。剪毛可获取羊毛，让它靠近公羊可随时间繁殖，也可将其屠宰。

Wolf Companion: A tame ram. Shear it for wool, keep it near tame sheep to impregnate them over time, or slaughter it for resources.
狼伙伴: 一只驯养的公羊。剪毛可获取羊毛，让它靠近驯养的绵羊可随时间使其受孕，也可将其屠宰以获取资源。

Wolf Companion: A sheep that recently gave birth. Use a clay bowl to milk it daily, shear it for wool, or slaughter it.
狼伙伴: 一只刚生产不久的母羊。每天用陶碗为它挤奶，也可剪毛取羊毛，或将其屠宰。

Wolf Companion: A young lamb. It will grow into a tame sheep or ram by the end of fall. You can feed it meadowgrass or straw to mature it early, or slaughter it for a small amount of meat and hide.
狼伙伴: 一只幼小的羊羔。到秋末它会长成驯养的绵羊或公羊。喂它草地牧草或干草可以让它提早成熟，也可将其屠宰以获取少量肉和兽皮。

Wolf Companion: Warmed sheep milk. Comforting and nutritious.
狼伙伴: 加温后的羊奶。暖心又营养。

Wolf Companion: Curdled sheep milk. Press it over a fire to make cheese and whey.
狼伙伴: 凝结的羊奶。在火上压制可制成奶酪和乳清。

Wolf Companion: Fresh sheep cheese. Leave it out to age into a richer variety — the spoilage bar fills as it ages.
狼伙伴: 新鲜羊奶酪。放置一段时间可熟成为风味更浓郁的品种——变质槽会随熟成而增长。

Wolf Companion: Richly flavoured aged sheep cheese. Excellent nutrition.
狼伙伴: 风味浓郁的熟成羊奶酪。营养极佳。

Wolf Companion: Liquid whey, a byproduct of cheese making. Mildly nutritious.
狼伙伴: 液态乳清，制作奶酪的副产品。营养温和。

Wolf Companion: Churned sheep butter. Rich in fat and calories. Drag a fire source onto it to clarify into pure fat.
狼伙伴: 搅打而成的羊乳黄油。富含脂肪和热量。拖动火源可澄清为纯净脂肪。

Wolf Companion: Tangy buttermilk, a byproduct of churning butter.
狼伙伴: 酸爽的白脱牛奶，搅打黄油的副产品。

Wolf Companion: Soft ricotta cheese made from reheated whey.
狼伙伴: 由重新加热的乳清制成的软质里科塔奶酪。

Wolf Companion: Raw wool sheared from a sheep. Spin it into yarn.
狼伙伴: 从绵羊身上剪下的生羊毛。可纺成纱线。

Wolf Companion: Spun wool yarn. Weave it into cloth by hand, or use it in place of yarn on any loom.
狼伙伴: 纺好的羊毛纱线。可以手工织成布料，也可以在任何织布机上代替纱线使用。

Wolf Companion: Woven woollen cloth. Provides a small amount of warmth. Use it to make warm clothing or blankets. Drag a knife onto it to cut it into cheese cloth.
狼伙伴: 编织而成的羊毛布料。提供少量保暖。可用来制作保暖衣物或毯子。拖动小刀可将其裁成奶酪纱布。

Wolf Companion: A warm woollen tunic that provides excellent insulation.
狼伙伴: 一件保暖的羊毛长衫，隔热效果极佳。

Wolf Companion: A thick woollen blanket. Greatly improves sleep quality in cold weather.
狼伙伴: 一条厚实的羊毛毯。在寒冷天气中能大幅提升睡眠质量。

Wolf Companion: Weave 4 woven cloths together into a thick woollen blanket.
狼伙伴: 将4块织布缝合成一条厚实的羊毛毯。

Wolf Companion: Metal shears for shearing sheep. Lasts 50 uses, then the blades are worn out and the shears are gone.
狼伙伴: 用于给绵羊剪毛的金属剪刀。可使用50次，之后刀刃磨损，剪刀便会报废。

Wolf Companion: A wooden butter churn. Use it to churn milk into butter and buttermilk.
狼伙伴: 一台木制黄油搅拌机。用于将羊奶搅拌成黄油和白脱牛奶。

Wolf Companion: Pack up the butter churn to carry it.
狼伙伴: 收起黄油搅拌机以便携带。

Wolf Companion: A butter churn, packed for transport. Use Place to set it up.
狼伙伴: 已打包便于运输的黄油搅拌机。使用「放置」来架设它。

Wolf Companion: Set up the butter churn in your environment.
狼伙伴: 在你所在的环境中架设黄油搅拌机。

Wolf Companion: A fine cloth used to curdle milk into cheese.
狼伙伴: 一块用于将羊奶凝结成奶酪的细纱布。

Wolf Companion: A wooden trough for storing herbivore feed (grasses, hay, and other forage) for your sheep.
狼伙伴: 一个木制饲料槽，用于为你的绵羊储存草食饲料（草、干草和其他牧草）。

Wolf Companion: Craft metal shears for shearing sheep.
狼伙伴: 打造用于给绵羊剪毛的金属剪刀。

Wolf Companion: Build a butter churn to make butter from milk.
狼伙伴: 建造一台黄油搅拌机，用羊奶制作黄油。

Wolf Companion: Cut woven cloth into a cheese cloth.
狼伙伴: 将织布裁剪成奶酪纱布。

Wolf Companion: Build a feeder to store feed for your sheep.
狼伙伴: 建造一个饲料槽，为你的绵羊储存饲料。

Wolf Companion: Occasionally spawns a wild sheep on the board.
狼伙伴: 偶尔会在场景中生成一只野生绵羊。

Wolf Companion: The shears' blades have worn too thin to cut and are no longer usable.
狼伙伴: 剪毛刀的刀刃已磨得太薄，剪不动了，无法再使用。

Wolf Companion: Milk the sheep to collect fresh milk.
狼伙伴: 为母羊挤奶以收集新鲜羊奶。

Wolf Companion: Begin your run with a small flock and shears: two tame sheep, a ram, a lactating ewe, and a pair of shears to start harvesting wool right away.
狼伙伴: 开局携带一小群羊和剪毛刀：两只驯养绵羊、一只公羊、一只泌乳母羊，以及一把剪毛刀，让你立即开始收获羊毛。

Wolf Companion: Start with wool, warm milk, and all processing equipment: a butter churn and cheese cloth. Everything you need to run the wool and dairy chains from day one.
狼伙伴: 开局携带羊毛、温羊奶以及全套加工设备：黄油搅拌机和奶酪纱布。第一天起就能运转羊毛和乳制品生产链所需的一切。

Wolf Companion: Begin your run with a tame sheep. Good for wool and dairy. Pairs well with Start with Shears.
狼伙伴: 开局携带一只驯养绵羊。适合获取羊毛和乳制品。与「携带剪毛刀起始」搭配良好。

Wolf Companion: Begin your run with sheep shears. Pairs well with Start with Sheep or Sheep Husbandry Kit.
狼伙伴: 开局携带剪毛刀。与「携带绵羊起始」或「养羊工具包」搭配良好。

Wolf Companion: Begin your run with a full breeding flock: a ram, a lactating ewe, and a lamb. Everything you need to build a flock from day one.
狼伙伴: 开局携带一整套繁殖羊群：一只公羊、一只泌乳母羊和一只羊羔。第一天起就能组建羊群所需的一切。

Wolf Companion: Occasionally spawns a wild ram on the board.
狼伙伴: 偶尔会在场景中生成一只野生公羊。

Wolf Companion: Spin raw wool into yarn by hand.
狼伙伴: 用手将生羊毛纺成纱线。

Wolf Companion: Weave two skeins of yarn into woven woollen cloth.
狼伙伴: 将两团纱线织成羊毛织布。

Wolf Companion: Sew a wool blanket into a warm woollen tunic.
狼伙伴: 将羊毛毯缝制成一件保暖的羊毛长衫。

Wolf Companion: Rich cream skimmed from fresh sheep milk. Fatty and filling.
狼伙伴: 从新鲜羊奶中撇出的浓郁奶油。油脂丰富，饱腹感强。

Wolf Companion: Tangy fermented sheep milk. More nutritious and hydrating than fresh milk.
狼伙伴: 酸爽发酵的羊奶。比新鲜羊奶更有营养、更能补充水分。

Wolf Companion: Sheep butter clarified over fire. Pure golden fat — extremely calorie-dense and long-lasting.
狼伙伴: 经火澄清的羊乳黄油。纯净的金黄脂肪——热量密度极高，耐储存。

Wolf Companion: Tangy cultured cream. Rich and filling.
狼伙伴: 酸爽的发酵奶油。浓郁而饱腹。

Wolf Companion: The lamb has grown into a full-sized sheep.
狼伙伴: 羊羔已长成一只成年绵羊。

Wolf Companion: A wooden sheep feeder, packed for transport. Use Place to set it up.
狼伙伴: 已打包便于运输的木制羊饲料槽。使用「放置」来架设它。

Wolf Companion: Set up the sheep feeder in your environment.
狼伙伴: 在你所在的环境中架设羊饲料槽。

Wolf Companion: Pack up the feeder to carry it.
Shear every ready tame sheep and ram nearby in one go.
狼伙伴: 一次性为附近所有准备好的驯养绵羊和公羊剪毛。

Wolf Companion: A quick-witted fox that has taken a liking to you. Keep it fed and watered or it will wander off.
狼伙伴: 一只机敏的狐狸对你产生了好感。保持喂养和给水，否则它会离你而去。

Wolf Companion: Give the fox a meal. Its ears perk up happily.
狼伙伴: 给狐狸一顿饭。它开心地竖起了耳朵。

Wolf Companion: Scratch behind its ears. It leans into your hand.
狼伙伴: 挠挠它的耳后。它靠向了你的手。

Wolf Companion: Chase each other through the ferns. Pure mischievous fun.
狼伙伴: 在蕨丛间互相追逐。纯粹的调皮乐趣。

Wolf Companion: Send the fox to nose around. It comes back with something useful.
狼伙伴: 让狐狸四处探查。它带着有用的东西回来了。

Wolf Companion: The fox flushes a partridge from the brush and chases it down. It trots back proudly.
狼伙伴: 狐狸把一只灰山鹑从灌木丛中赶出并追上了它。它骄傲地小跑回来。

Wolf Companion: Cup water in your hands for the fox. It laps eagerly.
狼伙伴: 将水捧在手心递给狐狸。它贪婪地舔饮。

Wolf Companion: Starved or parched too long, the fox collapsed and died. Its body remains.
狼伙伴: 长期忍饥受渴，狐狸倒下死去。它的尸体留了下来。

Wolf Companion: Apply the remedy to the fox's injuries. It holds still while you work.
狼伙伴: 将药物涂抹在狐狸的伤口上。它一动不动地让你处理。

Wolf Companion: Start with a curious fox companion.
狼伙伴: 开始时携带一只好奇的狐狸伙伴。

Wolf Companion: A silent owl that perches nearby and watches over your camp at night. Keep it fed and watered or it will fly away. By day it roosts in a nearby cave and rejoins you at night.
狼伙伴: 一只安静的猫头鹰栖息在附近，夜里为你的营地守望。保持喂养和给水，否则它会飞走。白天它会飞到附近的洞穴栖息，夜里再回到你身边。

Wolf Companion: Offer the owl a scrap of meat. It bobs its head approvingly.
狼伙伴: 给猫头鹰一块肉。它满意地点了点头。

Wolf Companion: Gently stroke its feathers. It closes its eyes in contentment.
狼伙伴: 轻轻抚摸它的羽毛。它满足地闭上了眼睛。

Wolf Companion: Let the owl stand guard while you sleep. You rest more deeply knowing it watches.
狼伙伴: 让猫头鹰在你睡觉时放哨。知道有它守护，你睡得更沉了。

Wolf Companion: The owl drifts silently into the undergrowth and returns with a mouse.
狼伙伴: 猫头鹰无声地滑入灌木丛，叼着一只老鼠回来了。

Wolf Companion: Starved or parched too long, the owl has silently flown off into the night.
狼伙伴: 长期忍饥受渴，猫头鹰悄然飞入夜色之中。

Wolf Companion: Apply the remedy to the owl's injuries. It sits still while you work.
狼伙伴: 将药物涂抹在猫头鹰的伤口上。它安静地待着让你处理。

Wolf Companion: Pour a small bowl of water for the owl. It drinks in quick precise sips.
狼伙伴: 为猫头鹰倒一小碗水。它啄饮几口，干净利落。

Wolf Companion: Start with a wise owl companion. By day it roosts in a nearby cave and rejoins you at night.
狼伙伴: 开始时携带一只睿智的猫头鹰伙伴。白天它会飞到附近的洞穴栖息，夜里再回到你身边。

Wolf Companion: Compressed and matted wool fibres. Can be cut and shaped into warm hats boots and other items without spinning or weaving.
狼伙伴: 压缩纠结的羊毛纤维。无需纺织即可裁剪塑形，制成保暖帽子、靴子等物品。

Wolf Companion: A thick felt hat shaped from compressed wool. Keeps the head warm in cold weather.
狼伙伴: 一顶由压缩羊毛塑形而成的厚实毛毡帽。在寒冷天气中保持头部温暖。

Wolf Companion: Dense felt boots that insulate the feet against cold ground. Traditional footwear for harsh winters.
狼伙伴: 一双厚实的毛毡靴，隔绝地面寒气，保护双脚。适应严冬的传统鞋履。

Wolf Companion: Wet and agitate raw wool to compress the fibres into a dense felt sheet.
狼伙伴: 将生羊毛浸湿并搅拌，把纤维压缩成一片厚实的毛毡。

Wolf Companion: Cut and shape felted wool into a warm winter hat.
狼伙伴: 将毛毡裁剪塑形，制成一顶保暖的冬帽。

Wolf Companion: Form thick felt sheets into boot soles and uppers then bind them with twine.
狼伙伴: 将厚实的毛毡片制成靴底和靴面，再用麻绳绑紧。

Wolf Companion: Slip the wolf a bone. It wags its tail furiously.
狼伙伴: 偷偷塞给狼一根骨头。它猛烈地摇着尾巴。

Wolf Companion: Offer the fox some dried berries. Its eyes light up with excitement.
狼伙伴: 给狐狸一些干浆果。它的眼睛兴奋地亮了起来。

Wolf Companion: Hold out dried meat. The owl blinks once then snaps it down.
狼伙伴: 递出一些肉干。猫头鹰眨了一下眼，随即一口叼下。
剪毛产生的蜡质副产品。

Wolf Companion: End the wolf's suffering with a quick knife. Its body remains.
狼伙伴: 用利刃迅速了结狼的痛苦。它的尸体留了下来。

Wolf Companion: Spend the day moving through the forest together. A quiet understanding passes between you. Can only be earned once.
狼伙伴: 花一整天时间与它一起穿行森林。你们之间流淌着一份静默的默契。此羁绊只能获得一次。

Wolf Companion: Quick and merciful. The fox does not struggle. Its body remains.
狼伙伴: 迅速而仁慈。狐狸没有挣扎。它的尸体留了下来。

Wolf Companion: Put the owl down. Yields a carcass that must be processed with a knife.
狼伙伴: 结果了猫头鹰。会得到一具需要用小刀处理的尸体。

Wolf Companion: Your bond with the wolf runs deep. Heightened instincts sharpen your tracking.
狼伙伴: 你与狼的羁绊深厚。敏锐的本能让你的追踪能力更加锐利。

Wolf Companion: Knitted wool socks. Worn beneath boots to keep the feet dry and warm.
狼伙伴: 针织羊毛袜。穿在靴子里能保持双脚干燥温暖。

Wolf Companion: Knit yarn into a pair of warm wool socks.
狼伙伴: 用纱线织成一双保暖羊毛袜。

Wolf Companion: A soothing skin balm of lanolin blended with frostleaf. Apply to chafed, wind-burned skin for lasting comfort. It does not spoil.
狼伙伴: 一种由羊毛脂与霜叶调制而成的舒缓护肤膏。涂抹于磨损、风吹皲裂的皮肤上可带来持久舒缓。它不会变质。

Wolf Companion: Blend lanolin with frostleaf powder into a soothing skin salve.
狼伙伴: 将羊毛脂与霜叶粉调制成舒缓护肤膏。

Wolf Companion: The owl did not survive the encounter. Needs a knife to process.
狼伙伴: 猫头鹰没能在这次遭遇中幸存。需要用小刀处理。

Wolf Companion: Pluck the feathers and salvage what meat you can.
狼伙伴: 拔掉羽毛，尽可能回收一些肉。

Wolf Companion: Command the wolf to hold its ground until called back.
狼伙伴: 命令狼原地待命，直到被召回。

Wolf Companion: Whistle for the wolf. It bounds over and falls into step beside you.
狼伙伴: 吹哨召唤狼。它跳跃着跑来，跟在你身边。

Wolf Companion: The fox curls up and refuses to budge until called.
狼伙伴: 狐狸蜷缩下来，不叫不动。

Wolf Companion: The fox perks its ears and trots after you once more.
狼伙伴: 狐狸竖起耳朵，再次小跑跟上你。

Wolf Companion: The owl settles onto a perch and stops trailing you.
狼伙伴: 猫头鹰落在栖木上，不再跟随你。

Wolf Companion: The owl takes wing and resumes shadowing your travels.
狼伙伴: 猫头鹰振翅飞起，再次悄悄跟随你的旅程。

Wolf Companion: Thick felt mittens that shield the hands from biting cold.
狼伙伴: 一副厚实的毛毡手套，抵御刺骨寒风，保护双手。

Wolf Companion: A sleeveless felt vest that adds an extra layer of warmth over the torso.
狼伙伴: 一件无袖毛毡背心，为躯干增添一层额外的保暖。

Wolf Companion: Cut and stitch felted wool into a pair of warm mittens.
狼伙伴: 将毛毡裁剪缝制成一副保暖的手套。

Wolf Companion: Cut and shape felted wool into a sleeveless vest.
狼伙伴: 将毛毡裁剪塑形，制成一件无袖背心。

Wolf Companion: A dense felt bedroll, warmer and easier to carry than a simple wool blanket. Nap or sleep on it as on any bedroll, and it keeps you warmer through a cold night.
狼伙伴: 一张厚实的毛毡睡垫，比普通羊毛毯更保暖、更便于携带。可以像普通睡垫一样在上面小睡或睡觉，寒冷的夜里能让你更暖和。

Wolf Companion: Felt a thick layer of wool into a warm, portable bedroll.
狼伙伴: 将厚厚一层羊毛毡制成温暖便携的睡垫。

Wolf Companion: A fenced enclosure for your tame sheep and rams. Sheep and rams left outside a pen overnight risk wandering off or falling to predators - a penned flock is safe while its fence holds. The fence wears down over about twenty days; once its Fence Condition reaches zero the pen protects nothing until you drag a Plank onto it to mend it.
狼伙伴: 一个围栏，用于圈养你驯化的绵羊和公羊。夜间未被圈养的绵羊和公羊有走失或被捕食者猎杀的风险；只要围栏完好，圈养的羊群就是安全的。围栏会在大约二十天内逐渐磨损，一旦围栏状况降到零，羊圈便无法再保护任何羊，直到你把一块木板拖到羊圈上将它修补好。

Wolf Companion: Pack up the pen to carry it. Any sheep or rams inside are set free onto the ground first.
狼伙伴: 收起羊圈以便携带。里面的绵羊或公羊会先被放到地上。

Wolf Companion: Nail a plank across the worn rails to restore half of the pen's Fence Condition.
狼伙伴: 将一块木板钉在磨损的栏杆上，恢复羊圈一半的围栏状况。

Wolf Companion: A fenced sheep pen, packed for transport. Use Place to set it up. It keeps its Fence Condition while packed: packing and placing the pen does not mend it.
狼伙伴: 已打包便于运输的围栏羊圈。使用「放置」来架设它。打包期间围栏状况保持不变：收起再放置羊圈并不会修补它。

Wolf Companion: Set up the sheep pen in your environment.
狼伙伴: 在你所在的环境中架设羊圈。

Wolf Companion: Build a fenced pen to shelter your sheep and rams overnight.
狼伙伴: 建造一个围栏羊圈，在夜间为你的绵羊和公羊提供庇护。

Wolf Companion: A small hammered bell on a rope collar. Hung where the flock beds down, its clank keeps loose sheep and rams from straying: with a Sheep Bell in the same place, unpenned sheep are half as likely to wander off overnight. It does nothing against predators.
狼伙伴: 一个系在绳圈上的小锤制铃铛。挂在羊群歇息的地方，它的叮当声能让散养的绵羊和公羊不再四处游荡：同一地点有羊铃时，未圈养的羊夜间走失的几率减半。它对捕食者毫无作用。

Wolf Companion: Hammer a metal nugget into a small bell and hang it on a rope collar for the flock.
狼伙伴: 把一块金属块锤成小铃铛，挂在绳圈上给羊群佩戴。

Wolf Companion: All that's left of a sheep or ram taken by a predator overnight. It was left unpenned - a Sheep Pen keeps the rest of the flock safe.
狼伙伴: 这是一只绵羊或公羊在夜间被捕食者猎杀后留下的残骸。它当时没有被圈养——羊圈能让羊群的其余部分保持安全。

Wolf Companion: Paw prints and drag marks lead away from the remains. Follow them to face the predator that took your sheep. With your Wolf Companion here the predator keeps its distance and you cannot follow it; a fox or owl at your side may scare it off before you catch up. The trail goes cold in about a day.
狼伙伴: 爪印和拖拽的痕迹从残骸处延伸而去。顺着它们追踪，去面对夺走你羊的捕食者。你的狼伙伴在这里时，捕食者会远远避开，你无法追踪它；身边的狐狸或猫头鹰也可能在你追上之前把它吓跑。足迹大约一天后就会消失。

Wolf Companion: Follow the trail away from the remains and face the predator. It takes half an hour.
狼伙伴: 顺着足迹离开残骸，去面对那只捕食者。需要半小时。

Wolf Companion: A scatter of downy grey feathers and a matted pellet of fur and small bones. Something silent hunted here.
狼伙伴: 散落着几根灰色的绒羽，还有一团裹着毛发和细小骨头的食丸。有什么无声的猎手来过这里。

Wolf Companion: Roasted cattail root melted with rich sheep butter. A hearty, filling meal.
狼伙伴: 将黄油融化在烤香蒲根上，做成丰盛饱腹的一餐。

Wolf Companion: Melt butter over roasted cattail root for a richer meal.
狼伙伴: 将黄油融化在烤香蒲根上，做成更丰盛的一餐。

Wolf Companion: A round of flatbread pressed full of sheep cheese. A satisfying, portable meal.
狼伙伴: 塞满羊奶酪的圆形扁面包。令人满足、便于携带的一餐。

Wolf Companion: Press sheep cheese into a round of flatbread.
狼伙伴: 将羊奶酪压入圆形扁面包中。

Wolf Companion: Mashed turnroot stirred with rich sheep cream. Smooth, filling, and hydrating.
狼伙伴: 拌入浓郁羊奶油的土根泥。口感顺滑，饱腹又解渴。

Wolf Companion: Stir rich cream into mashed turnroot.
狼伙伴: 将浓郁的羊奶油拌入土根泥中。

Wolf Companion: Caught alive in a snare, wings bound and furious. Must be fed regularly or it will work itself free. Can be released, or killed for its carcass.
狼伙伴: 被绳套活捉，双翅被缚，怒不可遏。必须定期喂食，否则它会挣脱逃走。可以放生，也可以杀死取其尸体。

Wolf Companion: Left hungry and unattended, the owl worked its bindings loose and vanished into the dark.
狼伙伴: 无人照料又饥肠辘辘，猫头鹰挣松了束缚，消失在黑暗之中。

Wolf Companion: Offer the bound owl a scrap of meat. It snatches it without gratitude.
狼伙伴: 给被缚的猫头鹰递上一块碎肉。它一把夺去，毫无谢意。

Wolf Companion: Cut the bindings and let it go. It climbs into the air without a sound, and will not come near this place again for some days.
狼伙伴: 割断绳索放它离去。它无声地腾空而起，接下来几天都不会再靠近这里。

Wolf Companion: A quick, ugly business. Leaves a carcass worth processing.
狼伙伴: 干脆而难看的活计，留下一具值得处理的尸体。

Wolf Companion: Sheep butter worked through with salt. It keeps far longer than the fresh kind.
狼伙伴: 揉入食盐的羊奶黄油，比新鲜黄油保存得久得多。

Wolf Companion: A wheel of sheep cheese hung in the smoke until the rind darkened. Keeps for a season.
狼伙伴: 悬挂在烟中熏至外皮发黑的羊奶酪，可以存放一整季。

Wolf Companion: Thick sheep yogurt stirred through with dried berries.
狼伙伴: 浓稠的羊奶酸奶拌入果干。

Wolf Companion: Boiled turnroot under a spoonful of sour cream. Plain food made worth eating.
狼伙伴: 煮好的翻根淋上一勺酸奶油，素寴的食物也变得可口。

Wolf Companion: A rye round split and heaped with soft ricotta.
狼伙伴: 切开的黑麦圆面包，堆满柔软的里科塔奶酪。

Wolf Companion: Hardtack soaked soft in buttermilk. Still plain, but no longer a jaw-breaker.
狼伙伴: 用酥乳泡软的硬饰，依旧素寴，但不再崩牙。

Wolf Companion: A cloth sack packed with owl down. Sleeping with it under your head takes the edge off a hard night.
狼伙伴: 填满猫头鹰细羽的布袋。柕着它入睡，难熬的夜晚也好过些。

Wolf Companion: Stuff a woven cloth with owl down and stitch it shut.
狼伙伴: 将猫头鹰细羽填入织布并缝合。

Wolf Companion: A marrow bone rubbed with dried meat. Kept aside for the wolf, not for the pot.
狼伙伴: 抹上肉干碎屑的骸骸，专为狼留的，不下锅。

Wolf Companion: Salted strips of meat cut small enough for a bird to swallow whole.
狼伙伴: 盐渍的肉条，切得足够小，能让鸟儿一口吞下。

Wolf Companion: Two kinds of dried berry rolled together. The fox can smell it through a closed pack.
狼伙伴: 两种果干拌在一起。即使包裹紧实，狐狸也能闻到。

Wolf Companion: Work dried meat into a marrow bone to make a treat a wolf will remember you for.
狼伙伴: 将肉干揉入骸骸，做成让狼心存感激的零食。

Wolf Companion: Cut meat into strips and salt them down for the owl.
狼伙伴: 将肉切成细条并用盐腌制，留给猫头鹰。

Wolf Companion: Roll two kinds of dried berry together into a fox's favourite.
狼伙伴: 将两种果干拌匀，做成狐狸最爱。

Wolf Companion: Cut free what the predator left - matted wool, the hide, and what meat and bone is still sound.
狼伙伴: 割下野兽留下的东西：结块的羊毛、兽皮，以及尚可用的肉与骨。

Wolf Companion: Work salt through the butter so it will keep past the warm months.
狼伙伴: 将食盐揉入黄油，让它能挢过暖季。

Wolf Companion: Hang the wheel in the smoke until the rind darkens and hardens.
狼伙伴: 将奶酪悬于烟中，直到外皮变黑变硬。

Wolf Companion: Gather the curds in the cheese cloth and squeeze them dry by hand. No fire needed, but the whey runs off and is lost.
狼伙伴: 用奶酪布包起凝乳，用手挤干。无需生火，但乳清会流失。

Wolf Companion: Fold dried berries through the yogurt.
Spoon sour cream over boiled turnroot.
狼伙伴: 将酸奶油淋在煮好的翻根上。

Wolf Companion: Split a rye round and pile the ricotta on.
狼伙伴: 切开黑麦圆面包，堆上里科塔奶酪。

Wolf Companion: Leave the hardtack in buttermilk until it gives under a thumb.
狼伙伴: 将硬饰泡在酥乳里，直到按下去发软。

Wolf Companion: Hand over the marrow bone you saved back. The wolf takes it carefully, then will not put it down.
狼伙伴: 递上你特意留下的骸骸。狼小心地叼住，一直不肯松口。

Wolf Companion: Offer the salted strips one at a time. The owl takes each from your fingers without a sound.
狼伙伴: 一条一条地递上盐渍肉条。猫头鹰无声地从你指间叼走。

Wolf Companion: Tip the mixed berries into your palm. The fox eats them out of your hand and stays close afterwards.
狼伙伴: 将混合果干倒在掌心。狐狸从你手中吃完，之后一直待在身边。

Wolf Companion: A wooden ard for a Bull to pull. Drag it onto a Fallow or Tilled Field while a Bull is with you to plough it.
狼伙伴: 一副供公牛拉的木犁。有公牛在身边时，把它拖到休耕地或耕地上即可犁地。

Wolf Companion: Hitch the Bull and plough the field. Tills it as a hoe would, in half the time and with far less effort.
狼伙伴: 套上公牛犁地。效果与用锄头耕地相同，但只需一半时间，也省力得多。

Wolf Companion: Build a wooden plough that a Bull can pull across your fields.
狼伙伴: 建造一副可由公牛拉动、在田地里耕作的木犁。

Wolf Companion: A thick rug of pressed felt with a darker border stitched on. Laid out in your camp, it makes the ground a little kinder underfoot.
狼伙伴: 一块厚实的压制毛毡地毯，四周缝有一圈颜色较深的毡边。铺在营地里，脚下的地面会舒服许多。

Wolf Companion: Lay felted wool into a thick rug and stitch a darker felt border around the edge.
狼伙伴: 将毛毡片铺成一块厚实的地毯，并在边缘缝上一圈颜色较深的毡边。

Wolf Companion: Counts the felt pieces worn at once (Felt Hat, Felt Mittens, Felt Vest, Felt Boots). Each worn piece adds 1, and three or more together add a little extra Cold Resistance, once. Never shown, and rebuilt from the worn pieces on every load.
狼伙伴: 统计同时穿戴的毛毡物件数量（毛毡帽、毛毡手套、毛毡背心、毛毡靴）。每件加1，三件或以上一起穿戴时，会额外增加少量抗寒，且只算一次。此项不会显示，每次读档时都会根据所穿戴的物件重新计算。

Wolf Companion: Three or more felt pieces worn together hold the heat in a little better, adding a small amount of Cold Resistance.
狼伙伴: 同时穿戴三件或以上毛毡物件，能更好地保存热量，额外增加少量抗寒。

Wolf Companion: A plank cart with a yoke for a Bull. Hold it in your hand to haul far more than a travois. While a Bull is on the board with you it adds no travel penalty.
狼伙伴: 带牛轭的木板车。握在手中可比拖橇运载多得多的东西。有公牛在身边时，它不会增加行程负担。

Wolf Companion: Nail a plank into the cart's frame to restore some of its durability.
狼伙伴: 将一块木板钉入车架，恢复部分耐久度。

Wolf Companion: Build a plank cart that a Bull can draw.
狼伙伴: 建造一辆可由公牛牵引的木板车。

Wolf Companion: A wolf den, packed for transport. Use Place to set it up.
狼伙伴: 已打包便于运输的狼窝。使用「放置」来架设它。

Wolf Companion: Set up the wolf den in your environment.
狼伙伴: 在你所在的环境中架设狼窝。

Wolf Companion: A sheltered hollow lined with wool, where your wolf can curl up. While your Wolf Companion shares this place with the den it loses Hunger and Morale a quarter more slowly.
狼伙伴: 一个铺着羊毛的遮蔽窝，你的狼可以蜷缩其中休息。当你的狼伙伴与狼窝处在同一地点时，它的饥饿和士气下降速度减慢四分之一。

Wolf Companion: Pack up the den to carry it.
Build a sheltered den where your wolf can rest.
狼伙伴: 建造一个遮蔽的窝，让你的狼可以休息。

Wolf Companion: An owl perch, packed for transport. Use Place to set it up.
狼伙伴: 已打包便于运输的猫头鹰栖架。使用「放置」来架设它。

Wolf Companion: Set up the owl perch in your environment.
狼伙伴: 在你所在的环境中架设猫头鹰栖架。

Wolf Companion: A tall roost of lashed poles for your owl. While your Owl Companion shares this place with the perch it loses Hunger and Morale a quarter more slowly.
狼伙伴: 用绳子捆扎长杆搭成的高栖架，供你的猫头鹰栖息。当你的猫头鹰伙伴与栖架处在同一地点时，它的饥饿和士气下降速度减慢四分之一。

Wolf Companion: Pack up the perch to carry it.
Build a tall perch where your owl can roost.
狼伙伴: 建造一个高栖架，让你的猫头鹰可以栖息。

Wolf Companion: A wolf pup, tamed young. Feed it meat and give it water to bring its growth along; in time it grows into a Wolf Companion. Only one wolf, pup or grown, can follow you at a time.
狼伙伴: 一只从小驯服的狼崽。喂它肉并给它水可以加快成长，久而久之它会长成狼伙伴。同一时间只能有一只狼（幼崽或成年）跟随你。

Wolf Companion: The pup has grown into a Wolf Companion.
狼伙伴: 幼崽已经长成了狼伙伴。

Wolf Companion: Give the pup a small meal. It grows a little faster.
狼伙伴: 给狼崽喂点肉。它长得快一点。

Wolf Companion: Offer the pup a drink from a water container.
Sift the owl's pellet for a feather or two and a few small bones. The track is used up.
狼伙伴: 翻看猫头鹰的食丸，找出一两根羽毛和几块小骨头。这处痕迹会被用掉。

Wolf Companion: Wool rinsed clean of grit and grease. It spins into more yarn than raw wool does.
狼伙伴: 洗去了沙砾和油脂的羊毛。它比生羊毛能纺出更多的纱线。

Wolf Companion: Rinse the wool with water from a container. Washed wool spins into twice the yarn.
狼伙伴: 用容器里的水冲洗羊毛。洗净的羊毛能纺出两倍的纱线。

Wolf Companion: Spin washed wool into yarn by hand: one washed wool makes two yarn.
狼伙伴: 徒手把洗净的羊毛纺成纱线：一份洗净的羊毛可纺出两份纱线。

Wolf Companion: Always on and never shown: while the Fox Companion shares your board, each leg of a journey takes one tick less (a leg that cost one tick becomes a moment). It does nothing without the fox.
狼伙伴: 始终生效且不显示：狐狸伙伴与你同处一地时，旅途的每一段少花一刻时间（原本只需一刻的路段会变成转瞬即逝）。没有狐狸则无效果。

Wolf Companion: The fox scouts the way, so travel takes a little less time.
狼伙伴: 狐狸在前面探路，所以旅途花的时间少了一点。

Wolf Companion: Stir wild garlic into this for a pungent flavour.
狼伙伴: 把野蒜拌进去，增添浓烈的辛辣味。

Wolf Companion: Stir wood sorrel into this for a sour, herbal flavour.
狼伙伴: 把酢浆草拌进去，增添酸味和草本香气。

Wolf Companion: Stir clover into this for a mild grassy flavour.
狼伙伴: 把三叶草拌进去，增添淡淡的青草味。

Wolf Companion: Stir nettle leaves into this for a grassy flavour.
狼伙伴: 把荨麻叶拌进去，增添青草味。

Wolf Companion: Stir frostleaf into this for a floral flavour.
狼伙伴: 把霜叶拌进去，增添花香味。

Wolf Companion: Stir juniper berries into this for a pungent, smoky flavour.
狼伙伴: 把杜松子拌进去，增添辛辣和烟熏味。

Wolf Companion: Stir wild garlic into this for a pungent flavour.
狼伙伴: 把野蒜拌进去，增添浓烈的辛辣味。

Wolf Companion: Stir wood sorrel into this for a sour, herbal flavour.
狼伙伴: 把酢浆草拌进去，增添酸味和草本香气。

Wolf Companion: Stir clover into this for a mild grassy flavour.
狼伙伴: 把三叶草拌进去，增添淡淡的青草味。

Wolf Companion: Stir nettle leaves into this for a grassy flavour.
狼伙伴: 把荨麻叶拌进去，增添青草味。

Wolf Companion: Stir frostleaf into this for a floral flavour.
狼伙伴: 把霜叶拌进去，增添花香味。

Wolf Companion: Stir juniper berries into this for a pungent, smoky flavour.
狼伙伴: 把杜松子拌进去，增添辛辣和烟熏味。

Wolf Companion: An owlet from a bird's nest. Feed it meat and give it water to bring its growth along; in time it grows into an Owl Companion. Only one owl, owlet or grown, can follow you at a time.
狼伙伴: 一只从鸟巢里找到的雏猫头鹰。喂它肉并给它水可以加快成长，久而久之它会长成猫头鹰伙伴。同一时间只能有一只猫头鹰（雏鸟或成年）跟随你。

Wolf Companion: The owlet has grown into an Owl Companion.
狼伙伴: 雏猫头鹰已经长成了猫头鹰伙伴。

Wolf Companion: Feed the owlet some meat to bring its growth along.
狼伙伴: 给雏猫头鹰喂点肉，让它长得快一点。

Wolf Companion: Offer the owlet a drink from a water container.
狼伙伴: 让雏猫头鹰从容器里喝水。

Wolf Companion: A keen-eyed hawk that rides the air above you and hunts hare and partridge on request. Keep it fed and watered or it will fly away.
狼伙伴: 一只目光锐利的鹰，在你头顶的空中盘旋，听你吩咐去猎取野兔和山鹑。要喂食喂水，否则它会飞走。

Wolf Companion: Offer the hawk a scrap of meat. It tears at it eagerly.
狼伙伴: 递给鹰一小块肉。它急切地撕扯着吃。

Wolf Companion: Hold out dried meat. The hawk blinks once, then snaps it down.
狼伙伴: 递上肉干。鹰眨了一下眼，随即一口叼走。

Wolf Companion: Pour a small bowl of water for the hawk. It drinks in quick sips.
狼伙伴: 为鹰倒一小碗水。它快速啄饮几口。

Wolf Companion: Put the hawk down. Yields a carcass that must be processed with a knife.
狼伙伴: 处死这只鹰。得到一具需要用刀处理的尸体。

Wolf Companion: Apply the remedy to the hawk's injuries. It sits still while you work.
狼伙伴: 给鹰的伤口敷药。你处理时它一动不动。

Wolf Companion: Gently stroke its feathers. It closes its eyes in contentment.
狼伙伴: 轻抚它的羽毛。它满足地闭上了眼睛。

Wolf Companion: The hawk climbs on the wind, stoops on something in the grass and brings it back. Sometimes it comes back with nothing.
狼伙伴: 鹰乘风盘升，向草丛中的猎物俯冲，再把它叼回来。有时它会空手而归。

Wolf Companion: The hawk settles onto a perch and stops trailing you.
狼伙伴: 鹰落在栖木上，不再跟着你。

Wolf Companion: The hawk takes wing and resumes shadowing your travels.
狼伙伴: 鹰展翅飞起，继续跟随你的旅程。

Wolf Companion: Starved or parched too long, the hawk has flown off over the treetops.
狼伙伴: 饥渴太久，鹰已经飞越树梢离去。

Wolf Companion: The hawk did not survive the encounter. Needs a knife to process.
狼伙伴: 这只鹰没能在遭遇中活下来。需要用刀处理。

Wolf Companion: Pluck the feathers and salvage what meat you can.
狼伙伴: 拔去羽毛，尽量保留可用的肉。

Wolf Companion: An eyas, a young hawk taken from a nest. Feed it meat and give it water to bring its growth along; in time it grows into a Hawk Companion. Only one hawk, eyas or grown, can follow you at a time.
狼伙伴: 从鸟巢里带回来的雏鹰。喂它肉和水，让它长得快一点；它终将长成鹰伙伴。一次只能有一只鹰（雏鹰或成鹰）跟随你。

Wolf Companion: The eyas has grown into a Hawk Companion.
狼伙伴: 雏鹰已经长成了鹰伙伴。

Wolf Companion: Feed the eyas some meat to bring its growth along.
狼伙伴: 给雏鹰喂点肉，让它长得快一点。

Wolf Companion: Offer the eyas a drink from a water container.
A tame ferret, small, quick and fond of burrows. Carry it and your Snares and Log Traps are more likely to catch a hare, as long as it is fed. Feed it scraps of raw meat; a hungry ferret helps less.
狼伙伴: 一只驯服的雪貂，身形小巧、动作敏捷，喜欢钻洞。带着它，只要喂饱了，你的陷阱和圆木陷阱更容易捕到野兔。用生肉碎块喂它；饥饿的雪貂帮不上多少忙。

Wolf Companion: Feed the ferret a scrap of raw meat to fill its Hunger bar.
狼伙伴: 给雪貂喂一块生肉碎，填满它的饥饿条。

Wolf Companion: A short whistle cut from a bone splinter, with one shrill note. Blow it and every companion you left behind in another place (told to Stay Here, or left where it could not follow) comes back to you, as hungry and as hurt as it was. The owl answers only at night and never comes into a cave or building.
狼伙伴: 一支用骨片削成的短哨，只有一个尖利的音。吹响它，你留在别处的每一个伙伴（被命令“留在这里”的，或留在它无法跟随之处的）都会回到你身边，饥饿和伤势都和离开时一样。猫头鹰只在夜里回应，而且从不进入洞穴或建筑。

Wolf Companion: Call back every companion you left in another place. It comes to you here.
狼伙伴: 召回你留在别处的每一个伙伴。它会来到你现在所在的地方。

Wolf Companion: An answering call: your companion is coming back to you.
狼伙伴: 远处传来回应：你的伙伴正在回到你身边。

Wolf Companion: Only your owl could hear it, and it will not come: it roosts by day and never comes into a cave or building.
狼伙伴: 只有你的猫头鹰听得到，但它不会来：它白天在栖息，而且从不进入洞穴或建筑。

Wolf Companion: Cut a bone splinter into a short whistle with one shrill note that your companions know.
狼伙伴: 把一块骨片削成一支短哨，吹出一个你的伙伴都认得的尖利音。

Wolf Companion: A young pig trained to root. Carry it and, when you dig with Herbs and Fungi installed, you are more likely to turn up a truffle, as long as it is fed. Feed it acorns or roots; a hungry hog helps less.
狼伙伴: 一头学会拱土寻物的小猪。带着它，若装有草药与真菌模组，挖掘时更容易挖到松露，前提是喂饱了它。用橡子或根茎喂它；饥饿的猪帮不上多少忙。

Wolf Companion: Feed the hog an acorn or a root to fill its Hunger bar.
狼伙伴: 给猪喂一颗橡子或一块根茎，填满它的饥饿条。

Wolf Companion: Show a fully trusting piglet an acorn and teach it to root for truffles.
狼伙伴: 给完全信任你的小猪看一颗橡子，教它拱土寻找松露。
